# OzoneUI (`oz-*`) — AI-Native Quad-Domain UI Framework

> Zero-dependency Web Standards framework (OKLCH Atmospheric CSS + Custom Elements). Works in plain HTML, PHP, React, Vue, Svelte, or streamed JSON via `<oz-renderer>`.

## Setup (Zero-Build)
```html
<html data-oz-mode="atmospheric" data-oz-theme="dark" data-oz-sound="on">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="dist/ozone.css">
<script type="module" src="dist/ozone.js"></script>
```

## Global Attributes, Branding & Modes
- `data-oz-preset="ozone | emerald | fintech | amethyst | ai | crimson | gaming | amber | luxury | ocean | saas | nordic | enterprise | daylight | quartz"` (zero-config global OR section-scoped `<section data-oz-preset="...">` palettes)
- `data-oz-brand="#RRGGBB"` + `data-oz-harmony="analogous | complementary | triadic | monochrome"` (auto-computes OKLCH palette from any HEX color)
- `data-oz-density="compact | default | spacious"` (UI density & corner geometry)
- `data-oz-brand-name="Client Name"` (global white-label company identity)
- URL auto-branding: `?preset=fintech&brand=10b981&name=PayFlow` (shareable client demo links)
- `data-oz-mode="atmospheric | precision"` (glass refraction vs crisp 1px enterprise)
- `data-oz-theme="dark | light"`
- `data-oz-privacy="true | false"` (blurs any `[mask]` PII/financial values)
- `data-oz-sound="on | off"` (procedural Web Audio micro-FX)
- `data-oz-icon-set="builtin | lucide | ph | tabler | solar | heroicons"` (global vector icon pack)
- `mask="blur | secret"` on `<oz-stat>`, `<oz-input>`, or table cells
- `exportable` on `<oz-chart>` (SVG), `<oz-table>` (CSV/JSON), `<oz-card>`
- `src="url | mock://metrics | mock://users | mock://products"` + `poll="5s"` for zero-JS live data

## Hallucination-Proof Prop Aliasing
All `<oz-*>` tags accept natural aliases automatically:
- `variant` = `type` | `color` | `theme` | `kind` (`primary|glow|glass|ghost|danger|success`)
- Text content works via innerHTML slot OR `label` | `text` | `title` | `content`
- Icons: Always use `<oz-icon name="...">` or `icon="..."` props (never raw OS emojis)

## Quad-Domain Components

### 1. Core Foundation
- `<oz-icon name="sparkles|chart-bar|bot|ph:planet|tabler:flame" set="builtin|ph|tabler|solar|heroicons" size="16" stroke="1.75" src="..." icon-class="..." glow spin>`
- `<oz-button variant="glow|primary|glass|ghost|danger|success" size="sm|md|lg" icon="..." icon-right="..." pill loading>`
- `<oz-card glass tilt glow="cyan|violet|emerald|amber|rose" title="..." subtitle="..." badge="..." exportable oz-morph-id="...">`
- `<oz-badge variant="cyan|violet|emerald|amber|rose|neutral" icon="..." pulse>`
- `<oz-input label="..." placeholder="..." type="text|password" mask="secret" icon="...">`
- `<oz-switch label="..." checked>`
- `<oz-tabs active="0"><button slot="tab">A</button><div slot="panel">...</div></oz-tabs>` (or `tabs="Overview,Users,Billing"`)
- `<oz-dialog title="..." open>`
- `<oz-avatar name="Elena Vance" status="online|busy|away|streaming" verified src="...">`

### 2. Admin Backends & BI
- `<oz-stat title="MRR" value="$128,400" delta="+32.4%" trend="up|down|neutral" sparkline="40,55,48,72,95,128" mask="blur">`
- `<oz-chart type="area|line|bar|donut" title="..." labels="Mon,Tue,Wed,Thu" data="120,180,150,290" glow="cyan" exportable src="...">`
- `<oz-table title="..." rows='[{"name":"...","status":"Active","mrr":"$4,200"}]' searchable exportable mask-cols="email">`
- `<oz-smart-view title="..." data='[...]' view="table|chart|cards|json">` (auto-morphs raw JSON between 4 views)

### 3. High-End Landing Pages
- `<oz-hero badge="v1.0" title="..." subtitle="...">...actions...</oz-hero>`
- `<oz-bento cols="3" sortable persist-key="dash-1">` (drag-and-drop card reordering)
- `<oz-pricing title="Pro" price="$49" period="/mo" popular features="A,B,C" cta="Start Free">`
- `<oz-marquee speed="28s">...items...</oz-marquee>`

### 4. Marketplaces & Social Networks
- `<oz-product-card title="..." price="$79" old-price="$129" rating="4.9" reviews="342" badge="Hot" category="AI" seller="Aether" gradient="cyan">`
- `<oz-rating value="4.8" max="5" interactive>`
- `<oz-post author="Elena Vance" handle="@elena" verified status="online" time="2m" likes="124" comments="18" shares="9" tags="OzoneUI,AI" content="...">`
- `<oz-composer placeholder="Share an update..." target="#feed">`

### 5. AI-Native & Spatial OS Layer
- `<oz-renderer schema='{"type":"oz-bento","props":{"cols":2},"children":[{"type":"oz-stat","props":{"title":"Users","value":"12,480","trend":"up","delta":"+18%"}}]}'>`
- `<oz-command auto-discover>` (`Cmd/Ctrl+K` palette)
- `<oz-inspector>` (`Alt+O` Theme DNA studio)

### 6. Layout, Navigation & Feedback
- `<oz-header variant="glass|floating|minimal|enterprise" brand="OzoneUI" badge="v1.0" links="Product,Docs,Pricing" max-links="4" cta="Start" search mobile-menu="slide|slide-left|modal|dropdown">`
- `<oz-footer variant="multi-col|minimal|status" brand="OzoneUI" columns='[{"title":"Platform","links":["Admin BI","AI Lab"]}]' status="Operational" newsletter>`
- `<oz-breadcrumbs items="Home,Admin,Telemetry" separator="arrow|slash">`
- `<oz-alert variant="cyan|violet|emerald|amber|rose" title="..." message="..." cta="Inspect" dismissible>`
- `<oz-progress label="GPU Usage" value="78" variant="cyan" show-value indeterminate>`
- `<oz-accordion items='[{"title":"Question?","content":"Answer."}]' multiple>`
- `<oz-timeline items='[{"time":"2m","title":"Deployed","desc":"Edge nodes","status":"emerald"}]'>`
### App shell & sidebar
- `<oz-app-shell heading="Overview" subtitle="...">` children: one `<oz-sidebar>`, any content, and `slot="actions"` buttons for the topbar. Add `fill` for a fixed-height app.
- `<oz-sidebar brand="Acme" icon="cpu" searchable user-name="Alex" user-email="a@x.io" active="Overview" persist-key="app" items='[{"title":"Main","items":[{"label":"Overview","icon":"layout"},{"label":"Customers","icon":"user","badge":"3","children":[{"label":"All"},{"label":"Segments"}]}]}]'>` Optional: `side="right"`, `variant="glass|solid|floating"`, `collapsed`, `width="280px"`. Collapses to an icon rail, becomes a drawer under 900px. Events: `oz-navigate`, `oz-collapse`. Put `data-oz-sidebar-toggle` on any button to toggle it.

### Form controls (all accept label, hint, error, disabled; all emit `oz-change`)
- `<oz-select label="Role" placeholder="Choose" options='[{"value":"a","label":"Admin","group":"Team"}]'>` (options may also be csv: `options="A,B,C"`)
- `<oz-checkbox label="Subscribe" description="Weekly email" checked>` (`indeterminate` supported)
- `<oz-radio-group label="Plan" value="pro" variant="cards" options='[{"value":"pro","label":"Pro","desc":"For teams"}]'>` (`inline` for a row)
- `<oz-textarea label="Bio" maxlength="240" rows="4" autosize>`
- `<oz-slider label="Budget" min="0" max="5000" step="50" value="1800" prefix="$" show-value>`
- `<oz-date-picker label="Start" type="date|datetime-local|time|month|week" min="2026-01-01">`
- `<oz-file-upload label="Files" multiple max-size="5" accept="PNG, JPG">` emits `oz-files` with `detail.files`
- `<oz-combobox label="Skills" multiple creatable value="A,B" options="A,B,C" placeholder="Search...">` (`detail.values` array)
### Parallax, Motion & Modern Interactive (Pack F — 49 total components)
- `<oz-parallax speed="1" direction="both|vertical|horizontal|mouse" tilt badge="Spatial" heading="Depth Layers" subtitle="...">` Multi-layer scroll + pointer parallax scene; put `[data-depth="-0.3"]`, `[data-depth="0.4"]` on child elements for independent depth motion.
- `<oz-reveal effect="fade-up|fade-down|zoom|blur|flip|slide-left|slide-right" delay="0" duration="680" stagger="90">` Scroll-triggered `IntersectionObserver` reveal animation.
- `<oz-spotlight color="cyan|violet|emerald|amber|rose" size="380">` Cursor-tracking radial spotlight surface wrapper.
- `<oz-drawer heading="Quick Inspector" subtitle="..." side="right|left|bottom" size="sm|md|lg|xl" trigger="#btn-id">` Slide-over drawer sheet with optional `slot="footer"`. Fires `oz-open`, `oz-close`.
- `<oz-dropdown label="Actions" icon="sliders" variant="glass" items='[{"label":"Duplicate","value":"dup","kbd":"⌘D"}]'>` Floating popover action menu with `oz-select`.
- `<oz-tooltip text="Save changes" position="top|bottom|left|right" shortcut="⌘S"><oz-button>Save</oz-button></oz-tooltip>`
- `<oz-stepper active="1" clickable steps='[{"title":"Setup","desc":"2 files"},{"title":"Theme","desc":"OKLCH"},{"title":"Ship","desc":"Edge"}]'>` Interactive wizard/pipeline stepper with `oz-step`.
- `<oz-kanban persist-key="sprint-v1">` Drag-and-drop Kanban board with quick task creation (`oz-kanban-move`, `oz-kanban-add`).
### Modern Calendar, Pickers & Inputs (Pack G — 53 total components)
- `<oz-calendar heading="Release Schedule" value="2026-11-24" events='[{"date":"2026-11-24","title":"Release","color":"cyan"}]'>` Standalone interactive calendar grid (`range` supported via `start`/`end`).
- `<oz-date-picker label="Launch date" range events='[...]'>` Floating glass calendar popover with quick presets (`Today`, `+7 Days`), single or range date selection.
- `<oz-slider label="Budget" min="0" max="5000" min-value="800" max-value="3600" range ticks prefix="$" show-value>` Single or dual-thumb range slider with optional ticks.
- `<oz-file-upload label="Assets" multiple accept=".png,.jpg,.json" max-size="10">` Dropzone with Browse Files pill button, image thumbnails, progress bars, and `files='[...]'` seed support.
- `<oz-color-picker label="Brand Color" value="#00b4d8">` Swatch + hex input + floating palette popover.
- `<oz-number-input label="Seats" min="1" max="100" value="5">` Numeric stepper (`−` / `+` + arrows).
- `<oz-otp-input label="Verification code" length="6">` Segmented code input emitting `oz-complete`.
### Zero-Config CDN (Works directly in Claude Artifacts / ChatGPT / Plain HTML)
```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/valldy31/ozoneui@main/dist/ozone.css">
<script type="module" src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/valldy31/ozoneui@main/dist/ozone.js"></script>
```
Or pin `https://ozoneui.nstudios.eu/dist/ozone.css` + `ozone.js`. All form controls with `name="..."` automatically work with `<form>` / `FormData`, and AI agents can read/populate forms via `Ozone.getFormData()` & `Ozone.fillForm({...})`.

### 12-Col Grid, Mobile App Primitives, AI Chat & Dev UI (Pack H — 65 total components)
- `<oz-grid cols="12" gap="24px">` / `<oz-col span="8" span-md="6" span-sm="12">` Responsive 12-column grid (or `<oz-grid min="260px">`, plus `.oz-grid-12` + `.oz-col-1..12` utility classes).
- `<oz-bottom-nav items='[{"id":"home","label":"Home","icon":"layout"},{"id":"alerts","label":"Alerts","icon":"activity","badge":"3"}]' variant="floating|docked" position="inline|fixed">` Mobile app / PWA bottom tab bar with safe-area padding.
- `<oz-fab icon="plus" label="Create" position="inline|bottom-right|bottom-left" items='[{"id":"ai","label":"Ask AI","icon":"sparkles"}]'>` Mobile Floating Action Button + speed-dial.
- `<oz-ai-chat heading="Assistant" model="Gemini 2.5 Pro" suggestions="Build layout,Audit contrast">` AI prompt + streaming chat widget emitting `oz-send`.
- `<oz-code-block title="app.html" lang="html" line-numbers code="...">` Syntax viewer with 1-click Copy button.
- `<oz-split-pane ratio="38"><div>Left</div><div>Right</div></oz-split-pane>` Draggable resizable split container.
- `<oz-tree active="forms">` Collapsible folder/file tree emitting `oz-select`.
- `<oz-hover-card heading="Elena" subtitle="Architect" badge="Pro"><a href="#">@elena</a></oz-hover-card>` Floating preview card on hover/focus.
- `<oz-pagination page="1" total="120" page-size="10">` Page navigation emitting `oz-page`.
- `<oz-skeleton variant="card|stat|avatar" lines="3">` Animated shimmer placeholder.
- `<oz-empty-state icon="box" heading="No results" description="..." cta="Reset">` Empty-state callout card emitting `oz-action`.

## Runtime JS API (`window.Ozone`)
- `Ozone.toast({ title, message, variant })`
- `Ozone.icons.setDefaultSet('builtin'|'ph'|'tabler'|'solar'|'heroicons')` / `Ozone.icons.register(name, svg)` / `Ozone.icons.setResolver(fn)`
- `Ozone.dna.presets` / `Ozone.dna.applyPreset('emerald')` / `Ozone.dna.fromHex('#6366f1', 'complementary')` / `Ozone.dna.fromLogoFile(file)`
- `Ozone.dna.setDensity('compact'|'default'|'spacious')` / `Ozone.dna.setBrandName('Solaris AI')`
- `Ozone.dna.getDeployHTML()` / `Ozone.dna.getShareURL()` / `Ozone.dna.getW3CTokens()` / `Ozone.dna.encode()` / `Ozone.dna.apply('...')`
- `Ozone.agent.moveTo('#id', { label: 'AI', action: 'click' })`
- `Ozone.morph(() => { /* DOM change */ })`
- `Ozone.inspectUI()` / `Ozone.getSchemaManifest()` / `Ozone.getAIPrompt()`
